center_projected_hierarchical_experiment.note: Hierarchical Leiden (zoom within clusters) guarantees perfect nesting by construction and achieves higher purity than flat Leiden on center_projected embeddings at 1000-scale.

compressed_resolution_ladder.product_implication: Compressed 5-level ladder preserves 100% purity delta but does NOT preserve strict nesting for most modes. Compressed ladder NOT universally valid — some modes require the full 7-level ladder. Per-mode depth decisions required.

nesting_metric_defect.summary: Parameterized compressed builders recorded mean_nesting_score as mean of 'nesting_consistency' (fraction of fine clusters with a valid MAJORITY parent label). For independent Leiden partitions this is ~1.0 by construction and is NOT nestedness. Honest definition: a fine cluster is nested iff all its non--1 members share ONE unique coarse parent label.
nesting_metric_defect.routing_tables_unaffected: zoom_mappings.json child_to_parent/parent_to_children remain valid navigation data (majority-parent routing); only the METRIC NAME over-claimed nesting.
nesting_metric_defect.key_audit_finding: honest strict-nesting means 0.3911-0.9632 for the 7 compressed-family modes; nesting_score=1.0 citeable ONLY for the 1000-scale by-construction modes with scope annotation and honest ladder mean (0.8722/0.8644); outcome_tfidf_174k_compressed nesting=1.0 is genuine
